name: Stale category totals when group empty (Total_Services__c / Total_Software__c)
expected: On every reprice, a category whose group is EMPTY must reset its total to 0/null (Total_Services__c/Total_Software__c/Total_Subscription__c=0 when no line of that Fortra_Product_Type__c exists); phantom Discount% from Subtotal(list) vs TotalPrice(net) divergence must be cured (explicit/0, not a huge negative or 100%).
actual: Controlled USD quote 0Q0WC000003FbGr0AK (own fixture, 1 Software/BoKS Perpetual line, Services+Subscription groups EMPTY): seeded Total_Services__c=555, Total_Software__c=666, Total_Subscription__c=999 then V21 Force-reprice (place isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[]). RESULT: Total_Software__c -> 0 (Software group NON-empty, aggregate ran), but Total_Services__c STAYED 555 and Total_Subscription__c STAYED 999 (EMPTY groups never reset). Earlier 0-line variant: seeded 777/888/999 -> all THREE stayed frozen after reprice. Real-data corroboration: 6 USD quotes carry non-zero Total_Services__c with ZERO Services lines on the cart (0Q0WC0000037tXV0AY svc=39000, 0Q0WC0000038M9h0AE svc=15000, 0Q0WC0000039Sub0AE/0Q0WC0000039DkH0AU/0Q0WC0000035Xkn0AE svc=15000, 0Q0WC000002FB5F0AW svc=9750); repricing them leaves the stale value. EUR/CAD quotes with a Services line present (0Q0WC0000036xy90AA line NTP=467.30, 0Q0WC000003ASz10AG line NTP=694.45) keep Total_Services__c=500 frozen across Force-reprice (aggregate not even refreshing a changed non-empty value to that field). Sub-claim 2 (phantom Discount%): the original SC-3345 list>>net phantom IS cured -- SC-3345 control 0Q0WC0000034U4D0AU shows Subtotal=TotalPrice=5231, Discount=0; FormulaBasedPricing3 (IF(ItemNetTotalPrice>TotalLineAmount,ItemNetTotalPrice,TotalLineAmount)->TotalLineAmount) + explicit guarded DiscountPercent (IF(ListPriceBuffer__c>0,Total_Discount_Amount__c/ListPriceBuffer__c*100,0)) are live in V21. The Discount=100 seen on the fixture is the headless-net-$0 harness artifact (line nets $0 -> TP=0), NOT a base-mismatch phantom, so it is not counted as a K-09 defect.
evidence: Controlled mixed-cart test (Services empty, Software present): https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FbGr0AK/view -> after V21 Force-reprice svc=555(stale)/sw=0(reset)/sub=999(stale), Disc=100(net-$0 artifact). V21 metadata: Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml V21 block (L110850-117406) -- Total_Services__c/Total_Software__c/Total_Subscription__c each appear EXACTLY ONCE, only as section-0-output of their GroupingAndAggregatePricing BKM step (ServicesAggregatePrice/SoftwareAggregatePrice/SubscriptionAggregatePrice parented to TotalServices/TotalSoftware/TotalSubscription AdvancedListFilter on Fortra_Product_Type__c) -- NO zero-init Assignment writing Total_X__c=0. defectStep: Total Services (#116) / Total Software (#117) / Total Subscription (#118) AdvancedListFilter groups + their Services Aggregate Price (#103) / Software Aggregate Price (#104) / Subscription Aggregate Price (#109) GroupingAndAggregatePricing rollups -- a SUM over an empty filtered group writes nothing, so Total_X__c retains the stale prior value; there is no preceding step that initializes Total_Services__c/Total_Software__c/Total_Subscription__c to 0 on every reprice. (FormulaBasedPricing3 #47 + DiscountPercent #44 already cure the list/net phantom-discount sub-claim.)
proposedFix: Add an unconditional zero-init for each category total BEFORE its aggregate (e.g. 3 Assignment/Formula steps that set Total_Services__c/Total_Software__c/Total_Subscription__c = 0 on every line/header pass, the SC-3345 Fix1 'category-reset' pattern cloned from DiscountPercent), so an empty group resets to 0 instead of leaving the stale prior value; OR enable the procedure header 'Initialize resources with default values' toggle. Mirror the same zero-init for Total_Discount_Amount__c. Described only -- NOT applied (validation only, no proc edits).
notes: Active proc = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23), confirmed Active 2026-06-29. Memory (project_quote_pricing_rollups) says SC-3345 was FULLY RESOLVED 2026-06-07 under V9 with Fix1 (3 category-reset =0 steps) + Fix2 (discount-sign clamp) + Fix3 (net-consistent Subtotal). In active V21, Fix2/Fix3 SURVIVE (DiscountPercent guarded formula + FormulaBasedPricing3 both present and the list>>net phantom is cured on 0Q0WC0000034U4D0AU), but the Fix1 category-zero-init is NOT effective: V21 has no step that writes Total_Services__c/Total_Software__c/Total_Subscription__c=0, so empty-group stale totals reproduce (smoke-tested live -- empty group keeps stale value, non-empty group resets). This is the documented SC-3345 'category totals don't reconcile' residual, now confirmed as a regression of Fix1 across the V9->V21 co-owned churn. Note serialized V21 metadata also lacks Fix1 in EVERY prior version (each Total_X__c = 1 ref/version), consistent with Fix1 having been done via the header toggle/UI rather than as a serialized step (per memory 'do line-scoped changes in the UI'); whatever the original Fix1 mechanism, it is inert in the live V21 runtime per the controlled reprice. Sub-claim 2 phantom Discount% is NOT a K-09 defect today. Anti-phantom-defect: the failing evidence is NOT a headless-net-$0 line -- the seeded 555/999 are deterministic DML values, the reprice succeeded, and the SAME reprice DID reset Total_Software__c (non-empty group), isolating the empty-group-no-reset behavior as the procedure defect. VALIDATION ONLY: created fixture scripts/apex/setupK09StaleCategoryTotalTestData.compact.apex + REST Force-reprice; no deploys, no proc/flow/Apex/metadata edits; proposedFix NOT applied.
verdict_reason: On a controlled USD reprice the Software aggregate reset (666->0) but the EMPTY Services/Subscription groups left stale prior values (555/999) instead of 0, and 6 real UAT quotes carry non-zero Total_Services with zero Services lines -- V21 lacks a zero-init for the category totals, so empty-category stale totals (SC-3345 Fix1 residual) are a live PROCEDURE-DEFECT.
